answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 35 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in quartz, verified in tide, and kernel names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 170 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
